prompt: Ink and watercolor illustration in the style of a fantasy cartographer's sketchbook: thick uneven black India-ink outlines with a dip-pen look, loose wet-in-wet indigo and deep teal washes, granulating pigment, warm ochre touches only for lit windows and lanterns, visible paper grain, wide cinematic panoramic landscape at night. No people, no text, no frame. The bottom fifth is a dark, empty, rocky shore foreground with a few tide pools, with no buildings or figures on it. The tide has come at the wrong hour: the sea has pulled back from a dark rocky island leaving bare wet reefs and stranded boats, while far out a great wall of water stands leaning against the sky like a frozen wave, lit by the moon. On the island, small and distant, a stone fortress with warm lit windows on the cliff top. Avoid: text, letters, captions, signature, watermark, frame, border, photorealism, 3D render, glossy digital painting, saturated colors, neon, anime style, gore
